title: Bark Is Peeling
text: Bark Is Peeling. These little goobers are a good idea, just not too well executed. They are a natural product I get that. Several of mine had lose bark on them that was coming off. I know I could glue it back, but that's kind of a pain. I painted one to use on my desk to hold art cards that I trade. The base is sturdy. They aren't particularly smooth on the surfaces if you are planning to wood burn or art on them.
